verdict.rationale: Omnara documents parity between API/CLI/SDK and dashboard for core agent operations (launch, monitor, approvals, MCP tools, skills, model config, webhooks) and provides a live OpenAPI spec, showing strong API-first design. However, some UI-surfaced features (e.g. Slack connector interactions, org/role management UI, organization model-provider setup flow) aren't explicitly confirmed as fully API-equivalent, and no independent/hands-on confirmation that 100% of UI actions are API-reachable. missing for 10: explicit API parity for role/permission management and Slack-based interactions, independent verification of full UI-API equivalence.
